name: medical-tourism-armenia
description: Medical tourism platform for patients travelling to Armenia for medical treatment.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @mta/shared" "npm run dev -w @mta/api" "npm run dev -w @mta/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mta/shared && npm run build -w @mta/api && npm run build -w @mta/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mta/shared && npm run lint -w @mta/api && npm run lint -w @mta/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mta/shared && npm run test -w @mta/api && npm run test -w @mta/web
